2610.08720.title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
2610.08720.paper_summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver, a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver.
2610.08720.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基礎的代理正在逐步推進科學和工程問題的解決，物理模擬作為一個具有挑戰性但實用的測試平台，正在出現，以重現複雜的物理現象，並應用於具身 AI、遊戲和電影。作為這類模擬的主要工具，求解器計算動態系統的狀態如何隨時間演變。構建這樣的求解器需要物理理解來識別適當的模型，數學推理來制定基本的動力學，以及軟體工程來將其實現為可執行的代碼，但 LLM 代理的這一能力仍然未被充分探索。為此，我們介紹了 WorldSolver，這是一個由 61 篇經典計算機圖形學論文中的物理現象衍生的 168 個模擬任務的基準，涵蓋 7 個物理領域。每個任務包含一個代碼框架，為場景提供固定的模擬環境，而求解器的實現則留給代理來完成。具體而言，我們從三個維度對它們進行評估：執行檢查以確保成功執行，視覺真實性以重現渲染模擬中的預期動態行為，以及物理合理性以進行基於物理的生成動態驗證。對前沿代理的實驗顯示，產生可執行的求解器本身就是一個挑戰，而滿足視覺和物理正確性則更為困難。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 的表現相對於其他評估的代理來說更好，但總體得分僅為 48.7% 和 46.7%。WorldSolver 是朝著代理求解器生成邁出的早期一步，我們希望它能促進朝著能夠忠實模擬動態物理世界的代理的進展。代碼可在 https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver 獲得。
